quotes.text: Have you noticed that Codex-generated websites tend to have these 01, 02, 03 numbers as part of card layouts? It's almost the em-dash equivalent for AI-built website detection.

quotes.extraction_note: Genuinely funny, specific observation about AI-generated design tells. Reads like a developer folk theory in the best way.
